checkedAlternates.risk: Mahjong is played at a table with pieces, like a board game.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Mahjong has no board; the whole game is built from tiles.
The classic Monopoly is a board game with a board, dice and tokens.
Tetris is a video game; the pieces exist only on a screen.

authorReview.notes: UNO and Monopoly are brand names, which are acceptable here because both are used as the genre's standard example.

blindPlaytest.notes: If testers argue over the Go row, replace Go with Checkers.
